profile.headline: Software Engineer at Ventyx

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develops test requirements, test plans, test cases and perform software verification and testing for: 
•  Configuration Manager: System user management, market participant management, pricing node management; asset ownership management, data security management, task scheduling 
•  Transaction Manager: Asset bidding, bilateral scheduling, managing market offers/bids, schedules and bilateral contracts, virtual bidding, schedule management 
•  Operation Manager: Coordinating and monitoring asset dispatch activity; unit operational parameter management at a default, daily and hourly level; outage management 
•  Settlement Manager: Shadow settlements, checkout, dispute management, invoicing 
•  Information Manager: Meter data, clearing prices, market data, market volumes, reporting

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: IBM – United States Postal Service / Automated Postal Centers (USPS / APC) Contract. Software Test Engineer.  The United States Postal Service has asked IBM to perform the complete verification of their new Automated Postal Centers (APC).  Performs system, integration, and regression testing of the postal self-service machines. Develops and executes test cases for system tests activities.  Responsible for testing of the systems maintenance and diagnostic functions, database functions, reports and various customer functions.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer - Space Operations Mission Directorate (SOMD)
positions.description:
•  NASA's Space Operations Mission Directorate (SOMD) is responsible for providing mission critical space exploration services to both NASA customers and to other partners within the United States and throughout the world.
•  Responsible of the Space Shuttle to assemble the International Space Station (ISS), operating the ISS, ensuring safe and reliable access to space, maintaining secure and dependable communications between platforms across the solar system, and ensuring the health and safety of our Nation's astronauts.
•  Develop and maintain Space Station Mission Flight Rules and Crew Operational Procedures documentation that interface with the EPS system 
•  Design graphical user interface prototype and requirements for Mission Control Console tools to monitor the space station on-board equipment status
•  Functional and system test each requirement on the Mission Control Console prototype
•  Interface with the development community to resolve software process/integration issues/concerns
•  Develop hardware briefing/presentation as educational tool for other department
•  Develop high-level schematics of the space station electrical power systems

positions.title: Field Electrical Engineer
positions.description:
•  Install and repair central safety alarm systems for various corporations
•  Troubleshoot two-way FM radio system, radar, loran, CB, AC/DC power supply and other electronic devices
•  Implement wiring schematics
